messages:
Clara P.: Quick check — prepping Friday KPI snapshot and noticed launch-post traffic up but demo requests flat. Can someone sanity-check sources?
Hector (analytics): Looking now. Dashboard pulls SFDC demo events; benchmark sheet uses HubSpot form completions. Expect some divergence.
June (demand): Also saw that webinar nurture cohort has higher visits but lower immediate demo CTA clicks. Might be messaging mismatch.
Ravi (growth): I pulled a short table by UTM_campaign and attribution window. 7d first-touch shows campaign A CR 3.2% but 30d last-touch 4.8%. Timing matters.
Clara P.: Can you paste the query you used?
Hector (analytics): ```-- simple cohort counts
SELECT cohort_source, attribution_window, count(distinct user_id) as users, sum(is_demo)/count(distinct user_id) as cr
FROM analytics.events
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-02-25' AND '2026-03-10'
GROUP BY 1,2;```
June (demand): Ops note: paid social ran 3/4-3/8 and webinar sends 3/6-3/9 — overlapping audiences could fuzz the signal.
Ravi (growth): Session replays for webinar cohort show confusion on pricing features. UX + messaging confound possible.
Clara P.: For the KPI slide let's include: (1) HubSpot vs SFDC counts, (2) CR by 7/14/30d windows, (3) small note on creative variant.
Hector (analytics): I'll add a toggle for windows and a sample-size column. Also annotate the SFDC webhook gap on 2026-03-07.
June (demand): I'll prepare two pricing CTA variants for a rapid test targeted at launch-post traffic.
Ravi (growth): I'll segment first-touch vs last-touch in the viz so leadership sees how attribution changes the headline rate.
MKTG-bot: "MKTG-bot: Weekly KPI sync Friday 10:00am 126-03-13 10:00AM 026-03-13 10:00AM 026-03-13 10:00AM 026-03-13"
Clara P.: Timeline: Hector EOD for viz, June CTA drafts by tomorrow AM, Ravi will upload session clips. We'll fold into one slide and call out data caveats.
Hector (analytics): On it.
June (demand): Thanks — will tag copy variants in the deck.
Ravi (growth): Hypothesis: messaging -> UX -> lower conversions; AB test should isolate. :mag:
